demos.title: Resolve resource conflicts
demos.description: Check booking requests against the calendar, create approved bookings, notify conflicts and email the report.
demos.descriptionZh: 对照日历检查预订请求，创建获批预订、通知冲突并发送汇总邮件。

demos.title: Research to a shopping plan
demos.titleZh: 从网页资料到采购计划
demos.description: Read a recipe, email the flavoring ingredients and schedule shopping relative to Thanksgiving.
demos.descriptionZh: 读取网页食谱，邮件发送调味食材，并按感恩节日期安排采购。

demos.title: A lecture into the calendar
demos.description: Find the Urban Mobility lecture under a hashtag, read its time and location, and create an event with a one-day reminder.
demos.descriptionZh: 在话题中查找 Urban Mobility 讲座，读取时间和地点，创建日历事件并设置提前一天提醒。

demos.title: Archive files and keep a record
demos.titleZh: 归档旧文件并邮件留档
demos.description: Select files older than a year, archive them, remove the originals and email the deleted-file list.
demos.descriptionZh: 筛选超过一年的文件，压缩归档、删除原文件并邮件记录清单。

demos.title: Organize photos by travel
demos.description: Read travel dates and locations from the calendar and sort last month's food photos into location folders.
demos.descriptionZh: 从日历读取旅行日期和地点，把上个月的美食照片归类到地点文件夹。

demos.title: Read a paper and count contributors
demos.titleZh: 读取论文并统计贡献者
demos.description: Find the downloaded Qwen3 paper, locate its core-contributor list and return the count in the requested format.
demos.descriptionZh: 找到下载的 Qwen3 论文，定位核心贡献者名单，并按任务指定格式回答人数。
